name: Axelrod culture: features and traits (Table 2)
description: Table 2 of Axelrod 1997: stable regions on a 10 × 10 lattice (four neighbors) for 5, 10 and 15 features × 5, 10 and 15 traits, each run to stability. The paper (10 runs each): 1.0, 3.2, 20.0 with 5 features; 1.0, 1.0, 1.4 with 10; 1.0, 1.0, 1.2 with 15. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-25): 1.1, 3.5, 22.0; 1.0, 1.0, 1.6; 1.0, 1.0, 1.0. More features mean fewer regions and more traits more, as the paper says.
